integrity: Proof supplies exact multiplication matrix, full determinant factorization, gradient singularity test, cofactor rank argument, and one-sided exceptional witnesses. Standalone checker uses exact SymPy arithmetic and 405 integer samples; sampling does not establish universal claims.
limitations: Only the canonical real Pentarnion algebra at parameter gamma=1. The uniqueness of the cubic projective singularity is over the real numbers. The three-dimensional source slice and canonical multiplication table are prior work. An unindexed equivalent global determinant calculation may exist; independent expert review is not performed.
title: Global left–right multiplication rank strata of the real Pentarnion algebra
